_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); discount-retail signals

pit_profile.why: Walmart: 'operates retail stores in various formats around the world and is committed to saving people money so they can live better'; 'every day low prices (“EDLP”)'; 'The retail business is highly competitive' (its Walmart U.S. segment competes with discount, department, drug, variety and specialty stores, supermarkets, supercenter-type stores and hypermarts, 'as well as internet-based retailers and catalog businesses'); and 'General economic conditions, globally or in one or more of the markets we serve, may adversely affect our financial performance' (its own FY2009 10-K): a low-price store network whose demand follows the consumer economy by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Walmart: 'operates retail stores in various formats around the world and is committed to saving people money so they can live better'; 'every day low prices (“EDLP”)'; 'The retail business is highly competitive' (its Walmart U.S. segment competes with discount, department, drug, variety and specialty stores, supermarkets, supercenter-type stores and hypermarts, 'as well as internet-based retailers and catalog businesses'); and 'General economic conditions, globally or in one or more of the markets we serve, may adversely affect our financial performance' (its own FY2009 10-K): a low-price store network whose demand follows the consumer economy by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B -0.04x; -32% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.40; conservative 2yr +80%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY00-FY09, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +5.9%/yr (Q1 ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +11.8%/yr (FY00-FY09 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +17.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY00-FY09); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: WMT (retrospective, 2009-07-02) ◉ BUY — Ratio B -0.04x (-8.8% downside to Bear $52 / +201.3% upside to Bull $144) | Adj composite 2.40 vs market 1.00: gap +1.40 [UNDERVALUED] | -32% above the EPP floor $70 (20x FY10E $3.52) | Conservative 2-yr case: +79.8% total (+39.9%/yr) | At 13.6x FY10E the 15% hurdle price $63 sits at or below the BASE case; U.S. comps +2.9% in Q1 FY10, forward sales +4.5% (no FY10 net sales guide in numbers, Q1 FY10 net sales at constant currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
